summary.en: Switch game installer and manager for the Game Agent.
summary.zh: 带通用游戏安装器的动森 Game Agent 管理工具。

details.en: Installs NSP, NSZ, XCI and XCZ packages from the SD card, an HTTP address or a phone/computer browser; no game content is hosted by this app. Installs the Game Agent for 3.0.3 automatically after a supported game or update, with SHA-256 verification for every file.
details.zh: 可从 SD 卡、HTTP 地址或手机/电脑浏览器安装 NSP、NSZ、XCI、XCZ；本应用不托管任何游戏内容。安装受支持的《集合啦!动物森友会》本体或更新后会自动安装 3.0.3 动森 Game Agent，所有文件逐项 SHA-256 校验。

changelog.en:
2.1.0 - Update Center checks Game Agent and ACNH-Manager from one signed manifest and updates either independently; Manager self-update verifies size, SHA-256, NRO identity and display version before replacing the standard NRO.
2.0.0 - general game installer for NSP/NSZ/XCI/XCZ; local card, HTTP download and browser upload sources; resumable transfers, storage selection, game metadata and cover display, a mirrored browser UI, HOME Menu shortcut management, focus-only Home navigation and clearer diagnostics.
1.0.2 - corrected unsupported-version detection for base-only installs and improved Details diagnostics.
1.0.0 - first public Game Agent installer with verified install/uninstall and signed update checks.
changelog.zh:
2.1.0 - 更新中心通过同一份签名清单检查动森 Game Agent 与 ACNH-Manager，并允许两项分别更新；Manager 自更新在替换标准 NRO 前核对大小、SHA-256、NRO 身份与显示版本。
2.0.0 - 通用游戏安装器支持 NSP/NSZ/XCI/XCZ，可从 SD 卡、HTTP 下载或浏览器上传安装；加入断点续传、安装空间选择、游戏信息与封面、浏览器镜像界面、桌面快捷方式管理、首页纯焦点操作和更清晰的诊断文案。
1.0.2 - 修正只装基础版时的版本不支持判定，并改进详情页诊断。
1.0.0 - 首个公开的动森 Game Agent 安装器，支持逐文件校验、安装/卸载与签名更新检查。
